//: Starter permissions config for a beginner's ~/.claude/settings.json. MERGE this in with the update-config skill (don't hand-edit). 'allow' pre-approves safe, read-only inspection commands so prompts only appear for commands that change something; anything that writes, deletes, installs, moves, or pushes is deliberately NOT listed, so it still asks. 'deny' blocks reading secret files outright. This is stack-agnostic on purpose — tailor it to what you actually run (Rails tasks, a browser driver, project MCP servers, etc.) with the fewer-permission-prompts skill once you've been working for a bit.
